starting-out-without-fishing-contest-com.player: Hi there, Veldaban! Have you got any new quests for me?

starting-out-without-fishing-contest-com.speaker: Commander Veldaban
starting-out-without-fishing-contest-com.text: Not at the moment, no, [player name].

starting-out-without-fishing-contest-com.player: That's too bad, I'm starting to get a little bored.

starting-out-without-fishing-contest-com.speaker: Commander Veldaban
starting-out-without-fishing-contest-com.text: Then perhaps you should try your hand at the Hemenster Fishing Contest.

starting-out-without-fishing-contest-com.player: Er, that's a bit of a random suggestion. Why would I go on a fishing contest?

starting-out-without-fishing-contest-com.speaker: Commander Veldaban
starting-out-without-fishing-contest-com.text: We dwarves don't know much about fishing, but a couple of our brothers at White Wolf Mountain want to win the competition.

starting-out-without-fishing-contest-com.player: Why would they want to do that if they don't know much about fishing?

starting-out-without-fishing-contest-com.speaker: Commander Veldaban
starting-out-without-fishing-contest-com.text: Ah, you see, the trophy is made of pure gold. And these dwarves in particular love gold.

starting-out-without-fishing-contest-com.player: Alright, sounds interesting, I'll check it out. White Wolf mountain, you said?

starting-out-without-fishing-contest-com.speaker: Commander Veldaban
starting-out-without-fishing-contest-com.text: Yes, you can speak to a dwarf at either side of the mountain.

starting-out-talking-to-commander-veldab.player: You mean, half the world has suddenly become a sailor?

starting-out-talking-to-commander-veldab.speaker: Commander Veldaban
starting-out-talking-to-commander-veldab.text: No, not that. It's the Red Axe!

starting-out-talking-to-commander-veldab.player: What have those grumpy little guys done now?

starting-out-talking-to-commander-veldab.speaker: Commander Veldaban
starting-out-talking-to-commander-veldab.text: They've left the city! They were already boycotting the trade floor, but now they've completely left the city.

starting-out-talking-to-commander-veldab.speaker: Commander Veldaban
starting-out-talking-to-commander-veldab.text: It's never happened before! At the moment it's unclear yet if they've left the Consortium as well. The directors are in turmoil!

starting-out-talking-to-commander-veldab.speaker: Commander Veldaban
starting-out-talking-to-commander-veldab.text: Well... I may require your services again. Are you interested in hearing more?

steps.player: Very interested!

steps.speaker: Commander Veldaban
steps.text: We need some more information about what the Red Axe is up to.

steps.player: Are you asking me to... spy on them? Isn't that treason?

steps.speaker: Commander Veldaban
steps.text: The other directors of the Consortium don't think so and are likely to expel the Red Axe completely anyway.

steps.player: So where would you like me to go?

steps.speaker: Commander Veldaban
steps.text: That's the problem. We don't know where they moved their headquarters to. But we may have one lead...

steps.player: Yes?

steps.speaker: Commander Veldaban
steps.text: There is a dwarf, all the way to the northeast in Keldagrim-East. He talks about kebabs a lot. Don't suppose you've met him?

steps.player: Yes, I do believe I have. Smashed glasses, wrecked house? Poor personal hygiene standards? Brother or cousin to that other drunken dwarf?

steps.speaker: Commander Veldaban
steps.text: That's him, poor fellow. He didn't always used to be like that.
Continues below at "But he seems to know something about the Red Axe for some odd reason."

steps.player: No, I don't believe so.

steps.speaker: Commander Veldaban
steps.text: He lives in his brother's house.

steps.speaker: Commander Veldaban
steps.text: Or was it his cousin?

steps.speaker: Commander Veldaban
steps.text: In any case, he's a bit of a drunk these days. Well, when I say a bit, he's actually smashed all the time.

steps.speaker: Commander Veldaban
steps.text: But he seems to know something about the Red Axe for some odd reason. He speaks of them sometimes in one of his many rants.

steps.speaker: Commander Veldaban
steps.text: Problem is, no one believes him. Everyone thinks he's completely mad. And perhaps they're right.

steps.speaker: Commander Veldaban
steps.text: But if he does indeed know something about the Red Axe or where their headquarters may be, we need to find out.

steps.speaker: Commander Veldaban
steps.text: What do you say then, [player name]? Do you want to help the Black Guard with this?

steps.player: Sounds like just the job for me!

steps.speaker: Commander Veldaban
steps.text: Excellent, good luck to you in your quest! May Guthix protect you!

A cutscene plays, showing the statue from The Giant Dwarf. "Rise of the Red Axe, Part II, Forgettable Tale of a Drunken Dwarf" appears on the screen, and the camera pans to the drunken dwarf's house. The player ends up in front of the house after the cutscene.

steps.player: Well, here I am... at the drunken dwarf's relative's residence, who is also drunken. I wonder what drunken tales he can tell me.
No, I try to stay away from drunken dwarves.
Although I wish they would try to stay away from me too...

steps.speaker: Commander Veldaban
steps.text: Very well. Come back when you change your mind.

steps.player: Some other time, perhaps.

steps.speaker: Commander Veldaban
steps.text: Very well.

starting-out-talking-to-commander-veldab.speaker: Commander Veldaban
starting-out-talking-to-commander-veldab.text: How goes the search for the Red Axe?

brewing-attempting-to-plant-kelda-seeds-.player: I'd better ask the gardener for permission to use this patch first.

brewing-talking-to-rind.speaker: Rind the gardener
brewing-talking-to-rind.text: Yes, [player name]? What can a humble gardener like myself help you with?

brewing-talking-to-rind.player: I have four Kelda seeds here, but need some advice on growing them.

brewing-talking-to-rind.speaker: Rind the gardener
brewing-talking-to-rind.text: Marvelous, those seeds are quite rare don't you know!

brewing-talking-to-rind.speaker: Rind the gardener
brewing-talking-to-rind.text: First of all, you must remember that these seeds only grow underground. Sunlight is harmful to them, for some strange reason.

brewing-talking-to-rind.speaker: Rind the gardener
brewing-talking-to-rind.text: There is a patch in the palace garden that you're more than welcome to use.

brewing-talking-to-rind.player: Thanks! Is there anything else I need to know?

brewing-talking-to-rind.speaker: Rind the gardener
brewing-talking-to-rind.text: Just take care of the weed in the patch and plant your seeds. They'll grow into hops very quickly, if you're lucky. Kelda seeds have a remarkably fast grow rate.

brewing-talking-to-rind.player: Thank you! Your advice is much appreciated!

brewing-talking-to-rind-again.speaker: Rind the gardener
brewing-talking-to-rind-again.text: Yes, [player name]? What can a humble gardener like myself help you with?

brewing-talking-to-rind-again.player: I think I need some more help with this whole farming business.

brewing-talking-to-rind-again.speaker: Rind the gardener
brewing-talking-to-rind-again.text: Just get rid of the weeds in the patch, plant you seeds and wait for the hops to grow. The miracle of nature will do the rest!

brewing-talking-to-rind-again.player: Do I have to wait here all this time then?

brewing-talking-to-rind-again.speaker: Rind the gardener
brewing-talking-to-rind-again.text: Yes and no. Yes, you do have to wait, but no, you don't have to stay here. You can help out people in the city, for instance, there's always someone who needs help with an urgent job.

brewing-talking-to-rind-again.player: You mean the mining companies? I did jobs for them, they're not very profitable.

brewing-talking-to-rind-again.speaker: Rind the gardener
brewing-talking-to-rind-again.text: No no, just people like shopkeepers and such, they're quite willing to teach you things in exchange for the jobs as well.

brewing-talking-to-rind-again.speaker: Rind the gardener
brewing-talking-to-rind-again.text: But here, tell you what, I'll give you some seeds if you can deliver this letter to a friend in Falador.

brewing-talking-to-rind-again.player: Do I have to do that? I just want to grow my hops and get on with my quest for Veldaban.

brewing-talking-to-rind-again.speaker: Rind the gardener
brewing-talking-to-rind-again.text: Oh no, you don't have to do it all, I just thought you wanted something to do while you were waiting.

options.text: Alright, I'll deliver that letter for you.

steps.player: Alright, I'll deliver that letter for you.

steps.speaker: Rind the gardener
steps.text: Happy to hear that! His name is Elstan, he lives just south of Falador.

brewing-talking-to-elstan.speaker: Elstan

brewing-talking-to-elstan.speaker: Elstan

brewing-speaking-to-rind-after-harvestin.text: You will have to bring your hops to a brewery.

brewing-speaking-to-rind-after-harvestin.speaker: Rind the gardener
brewing-speaking-to-rind-after-harvestin.text: Oh, there's one in Keldagrim-East, upstairs in the Laughing Miner. They brew their own beer they do.

brewing-speaking-to-rind-after-harvestin.speaker: Rind the gardener
brewing-speaking-to-rind-after-harvestin.text: I'm sure someone there will be able to help you out, it's not my specialty you see.

brewing-speaking-to-rind-after-losing-th.speaker: Rind the gardener
brewing-speaking-to-rind-after-losing-th.text: Yes, [player name]? What can a humble gardener like myself help you with?

brewing-speaking-to-rind-after-losing-th.player: I've grown my seeds into hops, but I seem to have mislaid them.

brewing-speaking-to-rind-after-losing-th.speaker: Rind the gardener
brewing-speaking-to-rind-after-losing-th.text: Ah! Fortunately I found some hops after your recent harvest. Here, I believe this belongs to you.

options.text: I need to know about the Red Axe...

steps.player: I need to know about the Red Axe...

steps.speaker: Drunken Dwarf
steps.text: I want my Kelda shtout!

steps.player: My hops still need fermenting, sorry.

brewing-attempting-to-add-kelda-hops-to-.text: These special hops need to be brewed in the Keldagrim brewery. Oh well...
This isn't the right time to be adding Kelda hops.

brewing-adding-kelda-hops-to-the-vat.text: You add some Kelda hops to the vat.

brewing-speaking-to-rind-while-the-kelda.speaker: Rind the gardener
brewing-speaking-to-rind-while-the-kelda.text: Yes, [player name]? What can a humble gardener like myself help you with?

brewing-speaking-to-rind-while-the-kelda.player: I'm brewing my hops into Kelda stout, but it seems to be taking an awfully long time.

brewing-speaking-to-rind-while-the-kelda.speaker: Rind the gardener
brewing-speaking-to-rind-while-the-kelda.text: Just have patience, my young friend! Have a wander around town, see if anyone has jobs for you!

brewing-when-the-kelda-stout-has-finishe.text: Perhaps I should have a look and see if my Kelda Stout has brewed...

brewing-speaking-to-rind-after-the-kelda.speaker: Rind the gardener
brewing-speaking-to-rind-after-the-kelda.text: Yes, [player name]? What can a humble gardener like myself help you with?

brewing-speaking-to-rind-after-the-kelda.player: I'm just so angry, my hops aren't fermenting at all. I want my Kelda stout!

brewing-speaking-to-rind-after-the-kelda.speaker: Rind the gardener
brewing-speaking-to-rind-after-the-kelda.text: Now now, my young human friend! Are you sure about that?

brewing-speaking-to-rind-after-the-kelda.speaker: Rind the gardener
brewing-speaking-to-rind-after-the-kelda.text: Perhaps you should go back to the brewery, I wouldn't be surprised if your stout has fermented by now.

brewing-turning-the-vat-valve-after-the-.text: The barrel now contains 1 pint of Kelda Stout.

brewing-leveling-the-kelda-stout.text: There is 1 pint of Kelda Stout in the barrel.

brewing-collecting-the-kelda-stout.text: You pour a glass of Kelda Stout.

brewing-attempting-to-drink-the-kelda-st.player: This stout seems absolutely vile and disgusting. Besides, I'm supposed to bring it to my drunken, kebab obsessed friend.

brewing-talking-to-the-laughing-miner-ba.speaker: Barmaid
brewing-talking-to-the-laughing-miner-ba.text: Welcome to the Laughing Miner pub, human traveller.

options.text: Who is that man walking around outside?
I'd like a Kelda stout please.

steps.player: I'd like a Kelda stout please

steps.text: If the player has a Kelda Stout:

steps.speaker: Barmaid
steps.text: They're quite hard to come by, and I believe you've already got one.

steps.player: Oh yes.

steps.text: If the player lost the Kelda Stout:

steps.speaker: Barmaid
steps.text: Here, I found a little left over Kelda stout, just enough for a glass. Take it.

steps.player: Wow, for free?

steps.text: Kelda stout

steps.speaker: Barmaid
steps.text: I don't think I'd be able to sell it to anyone.

steps.speaker: Barmaid
steps.text: So yes, go ahead.

brewing-talking-to-the-king-s-axe-inn-ba.speaker: Barman
brewing-talking-to-the-king-s-axe-inn-ba.text: Yes? Can I help you with something?

steps.player: I'd like a Kelda stout please.

steps.speaker: Barman
steps.text: They're not easy to come by... and I believe you already have one?

steps.player: Oh yes, you're right.

options.text: I need to know about the Red Axe...

steps.player: I need to know about the Red Axe...

steps.speaker: Drunken Dwarf
steps.text: I want my Kelda shtout!
If the player doesn't have Kelda Stout:

steps.player: Haven't got any on me, sorry.

steps.speaker: Drunken Dwarf
steps.text: Well hurry up! I'm dying of thirsht!
If the player has Kelda Stout:

steps.player: I've got some Kelda stout right here. I just brewed it in the Laughing Miner!

steps.speaker: Drunken Dwarf
steps.text: Now there'sh a good human, gimme that!

steps.player: Are you sure? This is pretty bad stuff.

steps.speaker: Drunken Dwarf
steps.text: You want to hear about the Red Kebabsh or what? I mean... the Red Axe.
Kelda stout

steps.player: Here you go then.

steps.speaker: Drunken Dwarf
steps.text: Ooooh, THAT'sh the good shtuff!

steps.speaker: Drunken Dwarf
steps.text: The Red Axe? You want to know about them, do you? Then let me tell you my tale. It is long and quite unforgettable...

steps.speaker: Drunken Dwarf
steps.text: A long time ago, quite a while ago, yes... I resigned from my mining company, the Magenta Accordion.

steps.player: The what? The Magenta Accordion? That's not a mining company!

steps.speaker: Drunken Dwarf
steps.text: It is, it is! It's one of the many minor companies, not part of the Consortium.

steps.player: Alright, if you say so...

steps.speaker: Drunken Dwarf
steps.text: Right, so I had just left my company. I'd had enough of slaving away in the mines and decided to become an explorer. Oh yes, like my cousin.

steps.speaker: Drunken Dwarf
steps.text: I explored this old mine, you know, just south of Keldagrim. I think it's boarded up now. Some amazing things I saw there.

steps.speaker: Drunken Dwarf
steps.text: First of all...
Screen fades.

steps.speaker: Drunken Dwarf
steps.text: ...and then I nearly fell into the Abyss! But I...
Screen fades.

steps.speaker: Drunken Dwarf
steps.text: ...so I had to run for my life, but then...
Screen fades.

steps.speaker: Drunken Dwarf
steps.text: ...pink dragons...
Screen fades.

steps.speaker: Drunken Dwarf
steps.text: ...and I don't really remember anything after that. People think I'm a drunken fool.

steps.player: That was very interesting! I'll ignore that part with the pink dragons though...
But I shall investigate that tunnel immediately! South of the cart station, just south of the carts to White Wolf mountain?

steps.speaker: Drunken Dwarf
steps.text: If you shay sho... I just want to smash up shome shtuff now.

options.text: I need to know about the Red Axe...

steps.player: I need to know about the Red Axe...

steps.speaker: Drunken Dwarf
steps.text: I don't know anyshing about the Red Kebabs.

steps.player: But that tale you told me!

steps.speaker: Drunken Dwarf
steps.text: I don't know what you're *hic* talking 'bout.

brewing-talking-to-veldaban-after-hearin.speaker: Commander Veldaban
brewing-talking-to-veldaban-after-hearin.text: How goes the search for the Red Axe?

brewing-talking-to-veldaban-after-hearin.player: I think I'm on to something! Something about a disused mine tunnel southeast of town.

brewing-talking-to-veldaban-after-hearin.speaker: Commander Veldaban
brewing-talking-to-veldaban-after-hearin.text: Happy to hear that, [player name]! Please go and check it out!

steps.player: Excuse me, can you tell me what's behind that boarded up tunnel to the south?

steps.speaker: Cart conductor
steps.text: Why, that part of the mines hasn't been used in a long time. I don't rightly know what you would find behind there.

steps.player: I need to go through there. Can you open up the tunnel for me?

steps.speaker: Cart conductor
steps.text: I don't have the authority to do that kind of thing.

steps.player: Then who do I talk to? I really need to get in.

steps.speaker: Cart conductor
steps.text: I don't know. Perhaps you have an influential friend?

steps.player: I really need to go through that tunnel.

steps.speaker: Cart conductor
steps.text: I can't help you, sorry.

steps.player: At least tell me who can, please?

steps.speaker: Cart conductor
steps.text: I don't know that either. Don't you have any influential friends in the city?

exploring-the-closed-tunnel-before-enter.speaker: Commander Veldaban
exploring-the-closed-tunnel-before-enter.text: How goes the search for the Red Axe?

exploring-the-closed-tunnel-before-enter.player: I think I may have a good lead now!
But I need some boarding removed, I need to go through some disused mine cart tunnels.

exploring-the-closed-tunnel-before-enter.speaker: Commander Veldaban
exploring-the-closed-tunnel-before-enter.text: I see... I cannot make that decision, I'm afraid. Speak to the director of [company name], he may be able to help you.

exploring-the-closed-tunnel-before-enter.player: Ah yes, I'm a member now, they must be able to help!

exploring-the-closed-tunnel-before-enter.speaker: [company name] Director
exploring-the-closed-tunnel-before-enter.text: Hello [player name]! Have you seen the statue? It looks beautiful! It's a pity it's been overshadowed by the departure of the Red Axe.

options.text: It's an honour to meet you!
Do you have any more tasks for me?
Can you help me with a boarded up tunnel?

steps.player: Can you help me with a boarded up tunnel?

steps.speaker: [company name] Director
steps.text: Ah, and what would be lurking behind this particular tunnel?

steps.player: I think it leads to something that might be related to the Red Axe.

steps.speaker: [company name] Director
steps.text: The Red Axe!

steps.speaker: [company name] Director
steps.text: This is indeed an important issue. They've gone too far this time. A major company willingly leaving the Consortium has never happened before.

steps.player: Can you help me get the boarding removed then?

steps.speaker: [company name] Director
steps.text: Forthwith, [player name], forthwith! I'll order the removal at once!

steps.player: Thanks! I'll investigate the tunnel immediately!

exploring-the-closed-tunnel-before-enter.speaker: Commander Veldaban
exploring-the-closed-tunnel-before-enter.text: And? What of the Red Axe?

exploring-the-closed-tunnel-before-enter.player: I will have lots to tell you soon, Veldaban!

exploring-the-closed-tunnel-room-1-enter.player: I'm deep underground now, but how am I supposed to get across here?

exploring-the-closed-tunnel-room-1-attem.text: You look at the strange machinery and feel as if you're missing something... perhaps something to put into those strange holes in the stone slab?

exploring-the-closed-tunnel-room-1-ridin.player: This junction is blocked. I'd better go back to the start and find some way to make it go left or right.

exploring-the-closed-tunnel-room-1-searc.text: You find a green stone and a yellow stone in the storage box. You wonder what you can use these for...
There is nothing more inside this box.

exploring-the-closed-tunnel-room-1-attem.text: You'd better hang on to this, it looks important.

exploring-the-closed-tunnel-room-1-searc.text: You search the box and find another stone with a green marking on it. Perhaps you should take the cart back to the start and see what you can do with it?

exploring-the-closed-tunnel-room-1-ridin.text: You take the minecart back to the start point.

exploring-the-closed-tunnel-room-1-searc.text: You search the box and find another stone with a yellow marking on it.

exploring-the-closed-tunnel-room-1-ridin.player: I've come to a dead end. I'd better get back to the start.

exploring-the-closed-tunnel-room-2-liste.speaker: Red Axe Director
exploring-the-closed-tunnel-room-2-liste.text: No, not yet. He may still prove useful to us.

exploring-the-closed-tunnel-room-2-liste.speaker: Red Axe Henchman
exploring-the-closed-tunnel-room-2-liste.text: My axe on his head would be more useful!

exploring-the-closed-tunnel-room-2-liste.speaker: Red Axe Director
exploring-the-closed-tunnel-room-2-liste.text: Forget about the human and the statue for now. Our experiments are more important.

exploring-the-closed-tunnel-room-2-liste.speaker: Red Axe Henchman
exploring-the-closed-tunnel-room-2-liste.text: We are nearly ready with our next test.

exploring-the-closed-tunnel-room-2-liste.speaker: Red Axe Director
exploring-the-closed-tunnel-room-2-liste.text: This time they'll survive, I hope.

exploring-the-closed-tunnel-room-2-liste.speaker: Red Axe Henchman
exploring-the-closed-tunnel-room-2-liste.text: Our slaves are too weak, it will never work.

exploring-the-closed-tunnel-room-2-liste.speaker: Red Axe Director
exploring-the-closed-tunnel-room-2-liste.text: Yes, things would have been so much easier with the statue.

exploring-the-closed-tunnel-room-2-liste.speaker: Red Axe Henchman
exploring-the-closed-tunnel-room-2-liste.text: It was a great plan! Sabotaging the base of the statue and bribing that boatman to crash into it!

exploring-the-closed-tunnel-room-2-liste.speaker: Red Axe Director
exploring-the-closed-tunnel-room-2-liste.text: And we would have gotten away with it too, if it wasn't for that pesky human.

exploring-the-closed-tunnel-room-2-liste.player: Pesky human, huh? Well, I think I have enough info now. I'd better explore the rest of these mines.

exploring-the-closed-tunnel-room-2-attem.player: I should stay and listen for a bit longer...

exploring-the-closed-tunnel-room-3-enter.player: Looks like another chasm I need to cross.

exploring-the-closed-tunnel-room-3-searc.text: You find a green stone and two yellow stones in the storage box.
You search the box and find another stone with a green marking on it.
You search the box and find yet another stone with a green marking on it.
The box turns out to be completely empty. And after all that effort to get here!

exploring-the-closed-tunnel-room-4-attem.player: I should explore this room fully before moving on. I should be able to find out a little bit more.

exploring-the-closed-tunnel-room-4-searc.player: Statistical data, salary structures, shopping lists... no, I don't think there's anything interesting here.

exploring-the-closed-tunnel-room-4-searc.text: You find a copy of a letter, addressed to the boatman that brought you to Keldagrim a while back.
You find something that seems to shed some light on what happened to the drunken dwarf in Keldagrim. You should read it carefully before moving on.
You find an interesting book that seems to contain a lot of data about Red Axe employees. You should read it fully before continuing.
You take the Red Axe Employee Records book from its shelf again.
You thoroughly search the bookcase but find no other books about the Red Axe.

exploring-the-closed-tunnel-room-5-enter.player: What the Guthix is this? Another chasm? And even more tracks!

exploring-the-closed-tunnel-room-5-searc.text: You find two green stones and two yellow stones in the storage box.
You search the box and find another two stones with markings on them: one green, one yellow.
You search the box and find another two stones with markings on them. Well, you know what to do with those by now...

exploring-the-closed-tunnel-room-6.player: There's the Red Axe director again!

exploring-the-closed-tunnel-room-6.speaker: Colonel Grimsson
exploring-the-closed-tunnel-room-6.text: The test subjects are still alive, director. They will suffice as soldiers.

exploring-the-closed-tunnel-room-6.speaker: Red Axe Director
exploring-the-closed-tunnel-room-6.text: Return to Arposandra and tell your superiors we've had a partial success.

exploring-the-closed-tunnel-room-6.speaker: Gnome emissary
exploring-the-closed-tunnel-room-6.text: I will tell them, but I'd like to see some of your test subjects first, if I may.

exploring-the-closed-tunnel-room-6.speaker: Colonel Grimsson
exploring-the-closed-tunnel-room-6.text: Look, here comes the first group!
Grunsh sneaks up on the player.

exploring-the-closed-tunnel-room-6.speaker: Grunsh
exploring-the-closed-tunnel-room-6.text: Lookings likes we's finding da spying creatures'ies!
Grunsh casts a spell on the player.
Screen fades out. The player appears back at the entrance to the tunnel.

exploring-the-closed-tunnel-room-6.player: Er, what? Where am I? Errrrr... I must tell Veldaban... something. Yes... ehm. I don't remember what though. Errr...

finishing-up-talking-to-veldaban.player: Veldaban, I must tell you something incredibly important!
I must tell you about... about...
...about my incredible craving for a kebab. Mmm, kebabs. A kebab and a beer, that sounds great right now.

finishing-up-talking-to-veldaban.speaker: Commander Veldaban
finishing-up-talking-to-veldaban.text: Errr, are you alright? Don't you have any important information about the Red Axe?

finishing-up-talking-to-veldaban.player: Mmm, yes, I'll be perfectly alright... just after I've had my beer and a kebab. Yes. I'll have a beer and a kebab in the Laughing Miner. Yum!
Watch out kebabs, I come for you!

finishing-up-talking-to-veldaban.speaker: Commander Veldaban
finishing-up-talking-to-veldaban.text: Poor [player name], I think you've been bewitched.

finishing-up-talking-to-veldaban-again.speaker: Commander Veldaban
finishing-up-talking-to-veldaban-again.text: [player name], I thought you had something important to tell me?

finishing-up-talking-to-veldaban-again.player: I will feast on kebabs and beer! Ahahaha!

finishing-up-final-cutscene.player: I knew it were you matey! 'Ere, have some of the good stuff!

finishing-up-final-cutscene.speaker: Factory Worker
finishing-up-final-cutscene.text: Tell us more about your kebabs!

finishing-up-final-cutscene.player: Right, these kebabsh, right? *hic* A whole g-g-group of kebabs came marching in! I'm telling you! Marching in line!
And then, I'll tell you... Then! Ehm...

finishing-up-final-cutscene.text: The player falls off their chair.

finishing-up-final-cutscene.speaker: Colonel Grimsson
finishing-up-final-cutscene.text: Ha, the spell has worked its magic again.

finishing-up-final-cutscene.speaker: Colonel Grimsson
finishing-up-final-cutscene.text: No one will believe that drunken fool now!
Congratulations, you've completed a quest: Forgettable Tale...

post-quest-talking-to-veldaban.speaker: Commander Veldaban
post-quest-talking-to-veldaban.text: What happened, [player name], did you finish your assignment?

post-quest-talking-to-veldaban.player: I think... I think I must have. It's so hard to remember.
I don't know, I think something terrible has happened, but everyone seems to think I'm an idiot for some reason...

post-quest-talking-to-veldaban.speaker: Commander Veldaban
post-quest-talking-to-veldaban.text: Don't worry, [player name], I believe you. You must have been put under a spell of some sort to make you forget.

post-quest-talking-to-veldaban.speaker: Commander Veldaban
post-quest-talking-to-veldaban.text: I suppose we'll just have to wait and see what happens.
